title: Aranya workspace layout
description: Every path an agent may write, with the schema each JSON/JSONL file must satisfy. `*` matches one path segment, `**` matches any depth. First match wins, so specific rules come first. A `readonly` rule is validated but only a human may change the file. The write-guard and validate scripts both read this file.

paths.description: Provision-indexed legal catalog: statutes, doctrines, cases, methodologies
Append-only log of flagged sections (provisions, EC conditions, report clauses)
Analysis findings, each citing a clause
Alternative calculator inputs, one file per labelled run
Chronology, analysis notes and argument drafts
Keeps the empty directory in git
Skills. Hooks, schemas and settings are left out on purpose: agents must not edit their own guards
